title.narrative: Festival Verdad 2011: Jovenes: Memoria, Seguridad y Paz

description.narrative:
Contribution to the Truth Festival, El Salvador which will be held in March 2011. This Festival is an academic, artistic and cultural event, which has been organised by long-standing CAFOD partner - Universidad Centroamericana (UCA) every year since 1993. The event has a special signicance for the Salvadoran people as a symbol of their struggle for the defence of their dignity, uncovering of the truth and an end to impunity for Human Rights abuses. This year's Festival will focus on young people of El Salvador - Remembrance, Security and Peace' and will include a number of diverse activities including a young people's photo exhibition, a conference about Monseñor Romero and the right of victims to the truth, young people's poetry, art and music competitions and a concert featuring national and international artists. The central part of the event will be a Restorative Justice Tribunal. The aim of the Festival is to raise awareness about the search for Truth, Justice and Peace among the population in general but in particular young people, organised groups and sectors of the civil service.
CAFOD will make a contribution towards the cost of travel, food and lodgings for the international jury members of the Restorative Justice tribunal.
